downstream_metric_definitions.hard_violation_count: sum of hard-constraint violations on the selected candidate.
downstream_metric_definitions.nodes_to_first_valid: 1-indexed proposal position of the first hard-feasible candidate, or candidate_count+1 if absent.
downstream_metric_definitions.nodes_to_optimal: 1-indexed proposal position of the first exact-optimal feasible candidate, or candidate_count+1 if absent.
downstream_metric_definitions.normalized_optimality_gap: max(0, optimum_value-selected_value) divided by the feasible objective range.
downstream_metric_definitions.top_1_feasible_discovery: 1 when the first proposed candidate is hard-feasible.
downstream_metric_definitions.top_k_feasible_discovery: 1 when any of the first k proposals is hard-feasible; k is preregistered by the future run.
downstream_metric_definitions.verifier_calls: number of exact candidate validation calls consumed by the proposal policy.
downstream_metric_definitions.wall_clock_s: descriptive timing only; it never admits or rejects a candidate.

field_principles.adversarial_controls: records omitted-constraint, omitted-candidate, duplicate, infeasible-best, shortcut, and objective-sign control detection.
field_principles.baseline_orderings: freezes solver-native, random, and deterministic energy-heuristic orderings before model use.
field_principles.benchmark_manifest_path: points to the full sealed instance manifest.
field_principles.benchmark_ready_score: strict benchmark-readiness scalar, not proposal accuracy.
field_principles.benchmark_row_hashes: seals each individual manifest row by instance id.
field_principles.blocked_reasons: lists mechanical blockers when the benchmark is not ready.
field_principles.candidate_domain_incomplete_count: blocks any incomplete finite candidate domain.
field_principles.candidate_pool_receipts: proves every bounded candidate pool is complete and duplicate-free.
field_principles.disjoint_from_v512_score: blocks row or experiment collisions with Exp5733/Exp5734.
field_principles.downstream_metric_definitions: preregisters decision-utility metrics before any GGUF run.
field_principles.exact_optimum_receipts: records exact feasible sets, optimum values, and optimal candidate ids.
field_principles.experiment: numeric experiment id for conductor and result indexing.
field_principles.family_counts: proves balanced coverage across finite CSP, MaxSAT, packing, and planning families.
field_principles.field_principles: every artifact field states the receipt boundary or preregistered metric it protects.
field_principles.generator_version: pins the deterministic benchmark generator implementation.
field_principles.hard_constraint_receipts: separates hard feasibility receipts from soft preference scoring.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal state starts complete: or blocked: and names the readiness boundary.
field_principles.llm_inference_used: bare false proves no GGUF or other LLM run contaminated benchmark generation.
field_principles.milestone: milestone accountability for this held-out benchmark build.
field_principles.model_specs: declares that no LLM model was invoked and names the exact offline generator instead.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: records Python, Rust, solver, RAM, disk, and v512 disjointness checks before dataset generation.
field_principles.random_seed: legacy scalar seed for methodology linters that do not unwrap random_seeds.
field_principles.random_seeds: records dataset, split, permutation, and control seeds.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: hashes the artifact with its checksum field blanked.
field_principles.result_path: records where the terminal artifact is expected to live.
field_principles.run_date: absolute run date prevents relative-date ambiguity.
field_principles.schema: names the artifact schema version for downstream validators.
field_principles.science_row_hashes: exposes the held-out science split commitment for future GGUF runs.
field_principles.soft_objective_receipts: separates soft objective receipts from hard feasibility.
field_principles.solution_receipt_failure_count: blocks candidate feasibility or objective receipt failures.
field_principles.solution_receipts: proves feasibility and objective value for every candidate.
field_principles.solver_versions: pins primary and independent exact solver implementations and host tool versions.
field_principles.spec_refs: binds the artifact to REQ-VERIFY-5746 and SCENARIO-VERIFY-5746.
field_principles.split_manifest: seals train/dev/science separation and split row hashes.
field_principles.structure_receipt_failure_count: blocks formulation-structure omissions independent of solver success.
field_principles.structure_receipts: proves every declared variable, domain, hard constraint, soft preference, and transition is represented.
field_principles.test_commands: records the focused, coverage, full-suite, spec, adversarial, and root-clutter commands.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: records observed or preregistered zero exit codes for verification commands.
field_principles.validator_disagreement_count: blocks primary versus independent exact-validator disagreements.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: bare true records exact validators as the only authority.
